name: tab-handoff
description: Hand files from one web app to another, tab to tab, with postMessage: no server, nothing uploaded, origin-locked and validated.
author: Florian Amette

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:exports
scripts.test:exports: node -e "const m = require('tab-handoff'); if (typeof m.sendHandoff !== 'function') process.exit(1)" && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('tab-handoff'); if (typeof m.receiveHandoff !== 'function') process.exit(1)"
